# OpenATS

> OpenATS is an open-source applicant tracking system for teams that want a clear, adaptable hiring process and ownership of their hiring data.

## About

- Website: https://openats.dev/
- Source code: https://github.com/chamals3n4/OpenATS
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Live demo: https://demo.openats.dev/

## Product scope

OpenATS supports job management, candidate tracking, interview coordination, hiring-team collaboration, AI-assisted resume parsing, and branded career pages. Sign-in is built in (email and password, with no outside identity service). It uses PostgreSQL for persistent data, Redis and BullMQ for background work, and an S3-compatible storage provider for resumes and attachments.

For the complete, long-form documentation index, see https://openats.dev/llms-full.txt.
